# `foreign_assistance_snapshots`

**Foreign assistance retained summary observations**

Retained country-summary versions and their separately pinned official dictionary.

**Coverage.** Window. Explicitly captured complete country-summary distributions, including valid empty files. Capture time is separate from publisher release date. An absent key in a later file is unobserved, never inferred deleted or zero. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `foreign_assistance_snapshots.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Exact identity of the selected summary and dictionary captures, including their observation times. |
| `observed_at` | `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE` | UTC instant at which this summary response was observed; not its fiscal year or publisher release date. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the complete original publisher CSV bytes. |
| `source_bytes` | `BIGINT` | Byte size of the complete original CSV. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact original country-summary request URL. |
| `dictionary_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the separately retained and reviewed publisher dictionary PDF. |
| `dictionary_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact publisher dictionary request URL. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted SpicyDocs release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted SpicyDocs artifact digest. |
| `source_row_count` | `BIGINT` | Original data records in the complete observed summary, before splitting current and constant dollars. |
| `publisher_release_date` | `DATE` | Unknown when the retained original does not state one; never copied from the capture clock. |
| `coverage` | `VARCHAR` | Snapshot-specific coverage limits and available provenance. |
| `source_scope_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete replay selection binding every original by URL, digest, size and observation time. |
